root_cause_label: Incorrect File Placement / Missing Required Artifacts
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent created all build artifacts (serial, pgen, Makefile) in /app/debruijn/ instead of /app/ without ever checking test expectations for file placement, causing the benchmark to miss every expected artifact.
t_err_evidence: Step 26: agent decides to create /app/debruijn/ as project directory ('Create a directory for our project') and step 27 cds into it, operating under the false assumption that a subdirectory is needed rather than placing artifacts directly in /app/.
t_commit_evidence: Step 28: agent writes serial.c into /app/debruijn/ via heredoc, locking in the wrong working directory. All subsequent build artifacts (serial, pgen, Makefile) are created under /app/debruijn/ from this point forward.
trigger_explanation: After failing to install Berkeley UPC and deciding to pivot to pthreads, the agent assumed without any basis that it needed to create a separate /app/debruijn/ subdirectory for the project. It never consulted the task spec to confirm expected artifact locations, acting on the false premise that a subdirectory was appropriate.
